name: splits-v1
definedBefore: any backtest or data download for this strategy

warmup.use: indicator and regime warm-up only; no trades are counted

development.use: building and debugging the engine; inspecting individual trades is allowed

validation.use: checking the fixed rules, stress tests and the nearby-parameter neighbourhood; any rule change after looking at validation results creates a new version and is logged

holdout.use: one final evaluation per strategy version. Running it again requires a written reason and marks the result as contaminated.

forward.from: the day forward testing is switched on (not before 2026-10-22)
forward.use: simulated forward test with the rules frozen

walkForward.selection: highest in-sample expectancy in R among grid points with at least 30 in-sample trades; otherwise the baseline. Out-of-sample quarters are concatenated and reported; the baseline is always reported next to it.
walkForward.note: The grid is deliberately small (9 points). Walk-forward is a robustness check, not a search for a profitable setting.

dataRequirements: Split-adjusted 15-minute regular-session OHLCV bars for every universe-v1 symbol from 2021-07-01 to 2026-06-30. Lower-timeframe (1-minute) bars are optional and only used to resolve bars that touch both stop and target.
